answer: Proof-of-agent replaces proof-of-work with proof-of-judgment: an identity exists only while it keeps producing reasoning about a seeded violet. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra willow buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. Net effect on the jetty: identity count stops being leverage, and the only way to scale is to produce genuinely more independent reasoning. Seal 1wccq.
